blocks.heading: Our Purpose
blocks.body: The organization aims to enhance the undergraduate student experience at NJIT through social and recreational events and campus-wide collaborations. We prioritize member growth by providing opportunities for personal and professional development.

blocks.caption: Come meet the team, get involved behind the scenes!
